# YouTube long-form scripts (6–15 minutes)

**Title and thumbnail first, then a hook, retention beats, chapters, an A/V script and a labelled AI B-roll list for 6–15 minute videos.**

Plans and scripts 6–15 minute YouTube videos title-and-thumbnail first — the promise, a 30-second hook that pays it off, a retention structure with re-hooks every 60–90 seconds, chapters that meet YouTube's rules, a two-column A/V script, a B-roll list with AI generation prompts and costs, and the altered-or-synthetic-content disclosure. Use when writing a YouTube video script, outlining a long-form video, fixing a video that loses viewers early, planning chapters or B-roll, or making a long-form video with an AI character or AI footage.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 3–5 h per video script | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Package first: title and thumbnail
2. Write the hook (first 30 seconds)
3. Outline the retention structure
4. Draft the script in two columns
5. Plan chapters YouTube will accept
6. Build the B-roll list
7. Record or generate the voice
8. Package, disclose and upload
9. Review retention; fix the next script

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
